name: JW Marriott Quito
positioning: Luxury hotel in the heart of Quito whose architecture is inspired by Ecuador's four natural regions, with a heated outdoor pool in tropical gardens and Zumay Health Club
best_for: Travelers who want a central Quito base minutes from the UNESCO-listed Historic Center
Guests who want a pool set in gardens and spa treatments in the city

facts.text: The hotel is located in the heart of Quito, Ecuador's capital.
The hotel's address is Avenida Orellana 1172 y Avenida Amazonas, Quito.
Suites and executive rooms feature private balconies.
Beds are the hotel's signature feather beds with plush duvets and pillows.
Suites have a living area and a separate living room.
Zumay Health Club offers massages, facials, therapy baths, body scrubs and wraps.
Serenity Spot is a wellness retreat at the hotel designed to inspire relaxation and renewal.
The hotel offers Sunrise Yoga & Sound Therapy.
There is a heated outdoor children's pool.
Botánica is a nature-inspired restaurant serving breakfast, lunch and traditional afternoon tea.
The hotel has 20 meeting and event venues.

highlights.text: The hotel's architecture is inspired by the four natural regions of Ecuador.
The heated outdoor pool is surrounded by lush tropical gardens.
Terrace Rooms are corner rooms with a king bed, a balcony and city views.
Quito's Historic Center, a UNESCO World Heritage Site, is minutes from the hotel.
Raíces is the hotel's signature fine dining restaurant, serving contemporary Ecuadorian cuisine that celebrates local ingredients.

considerations.text: Pets are not allowed at the hotel.
WhataHotel notes that Quito's high altitude may require acclimatization for some guests.
